主要内容: Novavax, Inc. executed Modification No. 13 to Project Agreement No. 01, dated July 6, 2020, with Advanced Technology International. The Modification amended the Project Agreement to include a Phase 3 efficacy study with respect to 2019n-CoV-301 in adolescents with a booster component and extended the performance period under the Project Agreement to December 31, 2023. The Modification will be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission as an exhibit to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021.
